312	def run_register() -> None:
313	    """Fill acquisition provenance in the manifest from the newest stamped capture per source.
314	
315	    retrieved_at comes from the UTC filename prefix (the file's creation time at save).
316	    text_sha256 hashes the normalised DOM text, so a later re-capture can tell real content
317	    drift from page noise without storing text (REQ-LIC-016). Only metadata is written.
318	    """
319	    manifest = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text())
320	    by_id = {s["source_id"]: s for s in manifest["sources"]}
321	    for folder in sorted(p for p in RAW.glob("S*") if p.is_dir()):
322	        files = sorted(f for f in folder.iterdir() if STAMP.match(f.name))
323	        if not files or folder.name not in by_id:
324	            print(f"skip {folder.name}: no stamped file or no manifest entry")
325	            continue
326	        f = files[-1]
327	        data = f.read_bytes()
328	        stamp = STAMP.match(f.name).group(1)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
329	        retrieved = datetime.strptime(stamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H%M%SZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
330	        text_sha = None
331	        if f.suffix == ".html":
332	            snap = Snapshot()
333	            snap.feed(data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
334	            text_sha = hashlib.sha256(norm(" ".join(snap.text)).encode()).hexdigest()
335	        acq = by_id[folder.name]["acquisition"]
336	        acq.update(
337	            {
338	                "retrieved_at": retrieved.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
339	                "retrieved_at_basis": "file creation time at save (UTC filename prefix)",
340	                "raw_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
341	                "text_sha256": text_sha,
342	                "byte_size": len(data),
343	                "private_path": str(f.relative_to(ROOT)),
344	            }
345	        )
346	        print(f"{folder.name}: {acq['retrieved_at']} sha256={acq['raw_sha256'][:12]} ({f.name})")
347	    # Terms-of-use copies in raw/rights/ update their host's rights record (hash + check time).
348	    rights = {r["rights_id"]: r for r in manifest["rights_records"]}
349	    for suffix, rights_id in RIGHTS_FILES.items():
350	        files = sorted(f for f in (RAW / "rights").glob(f"*_{suffix}.html") if STAMP.match(f.name))
351	        if not files or rights_id not in rights:
352	            continue
353	        f = files[-1]
354	        stamp = STAMP.match(f.name).group(1)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
355	        checked = datetime.strptime(stamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H%M%SZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
356	        rights[rights_id]["terms_checked_at"] = checked.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
357	        rights[rights_id]["terms_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
358	        rights[rights_id]["terms_private_path"] = str(f.relative_to(ROOT))
359	        print(f"{rights_id}: terms {rights[rights_id]['terms_checked_at']} ({f.name})")
360	    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
361

363	def main() -> None:
364	    command = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
365	    if command == "audit":
366	        run_audit()
367	    elif command == "register":
368	        run_register()
369	    else:
370	        sys.exit("usage: python -I scripts/snapshots.py {audit|register}")
371	
372	
373	if __name__ == "__main__":
374	    main()

"""Offline tooling for the manually captured HDB sources (docs/data_sources.md §7).

  audit     completeness audit of data/private_corpus/raw/<source_id>/ snapshots: headings,
            accordion labels, expected-concept presence, embedded page-data coverage, PDF
            page/date/text-layer facts and hashes
  register  write retrieved_at, hashes, size and private path into data/sources_manifest.json

Both print **structure only**, never passages of source text. Under D-054, source text must
not reach an external LLM, so this output is safe to share with the coding agent.
Stdlib only (D-036). Not used by the app or Docker (REQ-DAT-022).

Usage: python -I scripts/snapshots.py {audit|register}
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
RAW = ROOT / "data" / "private_corpus" / "raw"
MANIFEST = ROOT / "data" / "sources_manifest.json"
STAMP = re.compile(r"^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T\d{6}Z)_")  # UTC capture-time filename prefix
RIGHTS_FILES = {"hdb_terms_of_use": "R-HDB-WWW"}  # raw/rights/<UTC>_<suffix>.html -> record

SKIP_TAGS = {"script", "style", "noscript", "svg", "template"}
HEADING_TAGS = {"h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6"}
LABEL_MAX = 70  # truncate labels so no passage-length text is ever printed

# Expected MVP concepts per source (plan §2, §5). Regexes over lower-cased page text. A hit
# shows the concept is present in the capture; it does not verify any policy content.

def norm(s: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s.replace("\xa0", " ")).strip().lower()


class Snapshot(HTMLParser):
    """Collects visible-DOM text, headings, toggles, links, images and __NEXT_DATA__."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.text: list[str] = []
        self.headings: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        self.toggles: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        self.links: list[str] = []
        self.images: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        self.next_data = ""
        self.title = ""
        self._skip = 0
        self._in_next = False
        self._in_title = False
        self._label_stack: list[tuple[str, str, list[str]]] = []  # (kind, tag, parts)

    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:
        a = {k: v or "" for k, v in attrs}
        if tag == "script" and a.get("id") == "__NEXT_DATA__":
            self._in_next = True
        if tag in SKIP_TAGS:
            self._skip += 1
            return
        if tag == "title":
            self._in_title = True
        if tag in HEADING_TAGS:
            self._label_stack.append(("h", tag, []))
        elif "aria-expanded" in a:
            self._label_stack.append(("t", tag, [a.get("aria-expanded", "")]))
        if tag == "a" and a.get("href"):
            self.links.append(a["href"])
        if tag == "img":
            self.images.append((a.get("src", ""), a.get("alt", "")))

    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:
        if tag == "script":
            self._in_next = False
        if tag in SKIP_TAGS:
            self._skip = max(0, self._skip - 1)
            return
        if tag == "title":
            self._in_title = False
        if self._label_stack and self._label_stack[-1][1] == tag:
            kind, t, parts = self._label_stack.pop()
            if kind == "h":
                self.headings.append((t, norm(" ".join(parts))))
            else:
                self.toggles.append((parts[0], norm(" ".join(parts[1:]))))

    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
        if self._in_next:
            self.next_data += data
            return
        if self._skip:
            return
        if self._in_title:
            self.title += data
        self.text.append(data)
        for _, _, parts in self._label_stack:
            parts.append(data)


class _Strip(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.parts: list[str] = []

    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
        self.parts.append(data)


def strip_html(s: str) -> str:
    p = _Strip()
    p.feed(s)
    return " ".join(p.parts)


def json_strings(node: object, path: str = "$") -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    out: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        for k, v in node.items():
            out += json_strings(v, f"{path}.{k}")
    elif isinstance(node, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(node):
            out += json_strings(v, f"{path}[{i}]")
    elif isinstance(node, str):
        out.append((path, node))
    return out


def next_data_coverage(raw: str, dom: str) -> tuple[int, int, list[tuple[str, int]]]:
    """Share of content sentences in __NEXT_DATA__ that also appear in the DOM text.

    A sentence missing from the DOM means content that exists in page data but was not
    rendered at capture (e.g. unmounted panels). Returns (total, found, missing paths)."""
    if not raw.strip():
        return 0, 0, []
    total = found = 0
    missing: dict[str, int] = {}
    for path, s in json_strings(json.loads(raw)):
        if len(s) < 40 or s.startswith(("http", "/", "{")):
            continue
        txt = norm(strip_html(s) if "<" in s else s)
        for sent in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?:;])\s+", txt):
            if len(sent) < 30:
                continue
            total += 1
            if sent in dom:
                found += 1
            else:
                missing[path] = missing.get(path, 0) + 1
    return total, found, sorted(missing.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])


def short(s: str) -> str:
    return s if len(s) <= LABEL_MAX else s[: LABEL_MAX - 1] + "…"


def audit(path: Path, source_id: str) -> None:
    data = path.read_bytes()
    snap = Snapshot()
    snap.feed(data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
    dom = norm(" ".join(snap.text))
    print(f"\n=== {source_id}: {path.name}")
    print(f"bytes={len(data)} sha256={hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}")
    print(f"text_sha256={hashlib.sha256(dom.encode()).hexdigest()} dom_text_chars={len(dom)}")
    print(f"title: {short(norm(snap.title))}")
    m = UPDATED_RE.search(dom)
    print(f"last-updated marker: {m.group(0) if m else 'none found'}")

    print(f"headings ({len(snap.headings)}):")
    for tag, h in snap.headings:
        if h:
            print(f"  {tag}: {short(h)}")
    print(f"toggles with aria-expanded ({len(snap.toggles)}):")
    for state, label in snap.toggles:
        print(f"  [{state}] {short(label) or '(no text label)'}")

    print("expected concepts:")
    hits = 0
    for name, rx in EXPECTED.get(source_id, {}).items():
        n = len(re.findall(rx, dom))
        hits += n > 0
        print(f"  {'OK ' if n else 'MISSING'} {name} (matches={n})")
    print(f"  -> {hits}/{len(EXPECTED.get(source_id, {}))} present")

    print("links of interest:")
    for name, rx in LINK_PATTERNS.items():
        n = sum(bool(re.search(rx, h)) for h in snap.links)
        if n:
            print(f"  {name}: {n}")
    content_imgs = [
        (s, a) for s, a in snap.images if "/-/media/" in s or "infographic" in s.lower()
    ]
    print(f"content images ({len(content_imgs)}):")
    for src, alt in content_imgs:
        print(f"  {short(src.split('?')[0].rsplit('/', 1)[-1])} | alt_chars={len(alt)}")

    total, found, missing = next_data_coverage(snap.next_data, dom)
    print(f"__NEXT_DATA__ sentences rendered in DOM: {found}/{total}")
    for p, n in missing[:15]:
        print(f"  not in DOM: {n} sentence(s) at {short(p)}")


def audit_pdf(path: Path, source_id: str) -> None:
    """Byte-level PDF facts only: no parser dependency (D-052) and no text output (D-054).

    Counts and Info-dictionary dates are read with regexes over the raw bytes. They are
    indicative: compressed object streams can hide them, in which case 'not found' is shown.
    """
    data = path.read_bytes()
    print(f"\n=== {source_id}: {path.name}")
    print(f"bytes={len(data)} sha256={hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}")
    print(f"pdf header: {data[:8].decode('latin-1', 'replace')!r}")
    pages = len(re.findall(rb"/Type\s*/Page(?!s)", data))
    print(f"page objects (indicative): {pages or 'not found (object streams)'}")
    for key in (b"CreationDate", b"ModDate"):
        m = re.search(rb"/" + key + rb"\s*\(D:(\d{8,14})", data)
        print(f"{key.decode()}: {m.group(1).decode() if m else 'not found'}")
    print(f"font resources present (text layer likely): {bool(re.search(rb'/Font', data))}")


def run_audit() -> None:
    for sid in sorted(EXPECTED):
        for f in sorted((RAW / sid).glob("*.html")):
            audit(f, sid)
    for f in sorted(RAW.glob("S*/*.pdf")):
        audit_pdf(f, f.parent.name)


def run_register() -> None:
    """Fill acquisition provenance in the manifest from the newest stamped capture per source.

    retrieved_at comes from the UTC filename prefix (the file's creation time at save).
    text_sha256 hashes the normalised DOM text, so a later re-capture can tell real content
    drift from page noise without storing text (REQ-LIC-016). Only metadata is written.
    """
    manifest = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text())
    by_id = {s["source_id"]: s for s in manifest["sources"]}
    for folder in sorted(p for p in RAW.glob("S*") if p.is_dir()):
        files = sorted(f for f in folder.iterdir() if STAMP.match(f.name))
        if not files or folder.name not in by_id:
            print(f"skip {folder.name}: no stamped file or no manifest entry")
            continue
        f = files[-1]
        data = f.read_bytes()
        stamp = STAMP.match(f.name).group(1)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
        retrieved = datetime.strptime(stamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H%M%SZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        text_sha = None
        if f.suffix == ".html":
            snap = Snapshot()
            snap.feed(data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
            text_sha = hashlib.sha256(norm(" ".join(snap.text)).encode()).hexdigest()
        acq = by_id[folder.name]["acquisition"]
        acq.update(
            {
                "retrieved_at": retrieved.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
                "retrieved_at_basis": "file creation time at save (UTC filename prefix)",
                "raw_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                "text_sha256": text_sha,
                "byte_size": len(data),
                "private_path": str(f.relative_to(ROOT)),
            }
        )
        print(f"{folder.name}: {acq['retrieved_at']} sha256={acq['raw_sha256'][:12]} ({f.name})")
    # Terms-of-use copies in raw/rights/ update their host's rights record (hash + check time).
    rights = {r["rights_id"]: r for r in manifest["rights_records"]}
    for suffix, rights_id in RIGHTS_FILES.items():
        files = sorted(f for f in (RAW / "rights").glob(f"*_{suffix}.html") if STAMP.match(f.name))
        if not files or rights_id not in rights:
            continue
        f = files[-1]
        stamp = STAMP.match(f.name).group(1)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
        checked = datetime.strptime(stamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H%M%SZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        rights[rights_id]["terms_checked_at"] = checked.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        rights[rights_id]["terms_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        rights[rights_id]["terms_private_path"] = str(f.relative_to(ROOT))
        print(f"{rights_id}: terms {rights[rights_id]['terms_checked_at']} ({f.name})")
    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def main() -> None:
    command = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
    if command == "audit":
        run_audit()
    elif command == "register":
        run_register()
    else:
        sys.exit("usage: python -I scripts/snapshots.py {audit|register}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- validate ----------------
EXPECTED_SECTIONS = CORPUS_META / "expected_sections.json"
SENTENCE_MIN = 30


def sentences(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [s for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?:;])\s+", norm(text)) if len(s) >= SENTENCE_MIN]


def match_expected(spec: list[dict[str, str]], title: str) -> dict[str, str] | None:
    for item in spec:
        if re.search(item["match"], norm(title)):
            return item
    return None


def resolve_link(href: str, page_url: str, sources: dict[str, dict[str, object]]) -> str | None:
    """Manifest source ID a link points to, by canonical-URL prefix (anchors ignored)."""
    h = href.split("#")[0].split("?")[0].rstrip("/")
    if h.startswith("/"):
        h = "https://www.hdb.gov.sg" + h
    if not h:
        return None
    best: tuple[int, str] | None = None
    for sid, s in sources.items():
        for key in ("canonical_url", "original_url"):
            u = str(s.get(key) or "").split("?")[0].rstrip("/")
            if u and (h == u or h.endswith(u.split("://", 1)[-1])) and (
                best is None or len(u) > best[0]
            ):
                best = (len(u), sid)
        acq = s.get("acquisition")
        if isinstance(acq, dict):
            for key in ("requested_url", "final_url"):
                u = str(acq.get(key) or "").rstrip("/")
                if u and h == u:
                    best = (len(u), sid)
    _ = page_url
    return best[1] if best else None


def validate_source(
    rec: dict[str, object],
    raw_html: str,
    spec: list[dict[str, str]],
    sources: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
    snapshot_count: int,
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], dict[str, object]]:
    """Return (tracked summary with counts/IDs only, private detail with text fragments)."""
    sid = str(rec["source_id"])
    sections = rec["sections"]
    blocks = rec["blocks"]
    passages = rec["passages"]
    assert isinstance(sections, list) and isinstance(blocks, list) and isinstance(passages, list)
    passage_text = norm(" ".join(str(p["text"]) for p in passages))
    by_section: dict[str, list[dict[str, object]]] = {}
    for b in blocks:
        by_section.setdefault(str(b["section_id"]), []).append(b)
    detail: dict[str, object] = {"source_id": sid}
    issues: list[dict[str, str]] = []

    # 1. Accordions: toggles counted on the raw HTML, independently of the tree walker.
    raw_toggles = len(re.findall(r'class="accordion-button[^"]*"', raw_html))
    acc = [s for s in sections if s["kind"] == "accordion"]
    acc_rows = []
    for s in acc:
        own = [s["section_id"], *[x["section_id"] for x in sections
                                  if str(x["section_id"]).startswith(f"{s['section_id']}.")]]
        kinds = sorted({str(b["kind"]) for sec in own for b in by_section.get(str(sec), [])
                        if b["kind"] not in ("heading", "accordion_summary")})
        acc_rows.append({"section_id": s["section_id"], "title": short(str(s["title"])),
                         "body_block_kinds": kinds})
        if not kinds:
            issues.append({"kind": "extraction_failure", "where": str(s["section_id"]),
                           "detail": "accordion body has no extracted content"})
    collapsed = len(re.findall(r'aria-expanded="false"[^>]*>\s*<div class="PAccordion', raw_html))

    # 2. Expected sections from the matrix / data_sources §2.2 versus extracted headings.
    expected_rows = []
    seen_items: set[str] = set()
    for s in sections:
        if s["kind"] == "page":
            continue
        item = match_expected(spec, " > ".join(str(t) for t in s["path"][1:]))  # type: ignore[index]
        own_kinds = sorted({str(b["kind"]) for b in by_section.get(str(s["section_id"]), [])
                            if b["kind"] != "heading"})
        row = {"section_id": s["section_id"], "title": short(str(s["title"])),
               "scope": item["scope"] if item else "unexpected", "content": own_kinds}
        if item:
            seen_items.add(item["match"])
        else:
            issues.append({"kind": "unexpected_section", "where": str(s["section_id"]),
                           "detail": "heading not in the expected-section checklist"})
        expected_rows.append(row)
    for item in spec:
        if item["match"] not in seen_items:
            issues.append({"kind": "missing_section", "where": sid,
                           "detail": f"expected '{item.get('label', item['match'])}' not found"})

    # 3. Independent heading check with the snapshots.py parser (whole page, incl. chrome).
    snap = Snapshot()
    snap.feed(raw_html)
    extracted_titles = {norm(str(s["title"])) for s in sections}
    page_headings = [h for _, h in snap.headings if h]
    unmatched = sorted({h for h in page_headings if h not in extracted_titles})

    # 4. Text coverage: page-data sentences (Sitecore __NEXT_DATA__) found in the passages.
    missing_sents: list[str] = []
    total = found = 0
    if snap.next_data.strip():
        for path, s_ in json_strings(json.loads(snap.next_data)):
            if len(s_) < 40 or s_.startswith(("http", "/", "{")) or ".fields.meta" in path:
                continue
            for sent in sentences(strip_html(s_) if "<" in s_ else s_):
                total += 1
                if sent in passage_text:
                    found += 1
                else:
                    missing_sents.append(sent)
    dom_text = norm(" ".join(snap.text))
    in_dom_not_l1 = [x for x in missing_sents if x in dom_text]
    if in_dom_not_l1:
        issues.append({"kind": "extraction_gap", "where": sid,
                       "detail": f"{len(in_dom_not_l1)} rendered page-data sentence(s) not in "
                                 "passages (see private detail; card/meta text is expected)"})
    detail["page_data_sentences_missing"] = missing_sents
    detail["rendered_but_not_extracted"] = in_dom_not_l1

    # 5. Tables: count on raw HTML vs extracted; spans flagged for manual check.
    root_html = raw_html.split("DestinationLayout_DestinationPageLayout__Cont", 1)[-1]
    raw_tables = len(re.findall(r"<table\b", root_html.split("<footer", 1)[0]))
    tables = [b for b in blocks if b["kind"] == "table"]
    table_rows = []
    for t in tables:
        rows = t["rows"]
        spans = t.get("spans") or []
        assert isinstance(rows, list) and isinstance(spans, list)
        merged = sum(1 for r in spans for c in r if c != [1, 1])
        empty = sum(1 for r in rows for c in r if not str(c).strip())
        table_rows.append({"block_id": t["block_id"], "section_id": t["section_id"],
                           "rows": len(rows), "cells": sum(len(r) for r in rows),
                           "header_rows": t.get("header_rows"), "merged_cells": merged,
                           "empty_cells": empty, "nested_in": t.get("nested_in")})
        if merged:
            issues.append({"kind": "manual_check", "where": str(t["block_id"]),
                           "detail": f"{merged} merged cell(s): confirm which rows a value "
                                     "applies to against the rendered page"})
    if raw_tables != len(tables):
        issues.append({"kind": "extraction_failure", "where": sid,
                       "detail": f"raw <table> count {raw_tables} != extracted {len(tables)}"})

    # 6. Links: classified and resolved against the manifest.
    link_rows: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    for b in blocks:
        for ln in b.get("links", []) or []:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            href = str(ln["href"])
            if ln["kind"] in ("image", "video"):
                continue
            target = resolve_link(href, "", sources)
            key = href.split("?si=")[0]
            row = link_rows.setdefault(key, {"href": key[:160], "kind": ln["kind"],
                                             "target_source_id": target, "count": 0,
                                             "sections": []})
            row["count"] = int(row["count"]) + 1  # type: ignore[call-overload]
            secs = row["sections"]
            assert isinstance(secs, list)
            if b["section_id"] not in secs:
                secs.append(b["section_id"])
    for row in link_rows.values():
        t = row["target_source_id"]
        row["status"] = (
            "same_page" if row["kind"] == "same_page" and t in (None, sid)
            else f"manifest:{sources[str(t)]['mvp_class']}" if t
            else "transactional_or_service" if re.search(r"services2|homes\.hdb|iam\.hdb|singpass",
                                                        str(row["href"]))
            else "unmapped"
        )

    # 7. Duplicates and malformed passages.
    hashes: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for p in passages:
        hashes.setdefault(str(p["text_sha256"]), []).append(str(p["passage_id"]))
    dup_blocks: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for b in blocks:
        if b["kind"] in ("paragraph", "list", "table", "footnote") and len(str(b["text"])) > 60:
            dup_blocks.setdefault(hashlib.sha256(norm(str(b["text"])).encode()).hexdigest(),
                                  []).append(str(b["block_id"]))
    empty_sections = [s["section_id"] for s in sections
                      if not [b for b in by_section.get(str(s["section_id"]), [])
                              if b["kind"] != "heading"]]
    ids = [p["passage_id"] for p in passages]

    # 8. Temporal metadata.
    temporal = {
        "retrieved_at": sorted({str(p["retrieved_at"]) for p in passages}),
        "page_last_updated": sorted({str(p["page_last_updated"]) for p in passages}),
        "effective_date_known": any(p["policy_effective_date"] for p in passages),
    }
    if not temporal["effective_date_known"]:
        issues.append({"kind": "temporal_gap", "where": sid,
                       "detail": "no stated effective date; page 'last updated' date only"})
    if snapshot_count < 2:
        issues.append({"kind": "limitation", "where": sid,
                       "detail": "single default-state snapshot: no default-vs-expanded diff. "
                                 "Mitigation: collapsed panels present in DOM + page-data check"})

    summary = {
        "source_id": sid,
        "raw_sha256": rec["raw_sha256"],
        "extractor_version": rec["extractor_version"],
        "snapshots": snapshot_count,
        "counts": {
            "sections": len(sections), "passages": len(passages), "blocks": len(blocks),
            "tables": len(tables), "raw_tables": raw_tables,
            "accordions_extracted": len(acc), "accordion_toggles_raw": raw_toggles,
            "accordions_collapsed_at_capture": collapsed,
        },
        "accordions": acc_rows,
        "sections": expected_rows,
        "headings_not_extracted": {"count": len(unmatched), "labels": [short(h) for h in unmatched]},
        "page_data_coverage": {"sentences": total, "in_passages": found,
                               "rendered_but_not_extracted": len(in_dom_not_l1)},
        "tables": table_rows,
        "links": sorted(link_rows.values(), key=lambda r: str(r["href"])),
        "duplicates": {
            "passages": [v for v in hashes.values() if len(v) > 1],
            "blocks": [v for v in dup_blocks.values() if len(v) > 1],
        },
        "empty_sections": empty_sections,
        "passage_ids_unique": len(ids) == len(set(ids)),
        "temporal": temporal,
        "issues": issues,
    }
    return summary, detail


def run_validate() -> None:
    from snapshots import json_strings as _js  # noqa: F401  (import check only)

    spec_all = json.loads(EXPECTED_SECTIONS.read_text())
    sources = manifest_sources()
    reports, details = [], []
    for sid in sorted(spec_all["html"]):
        rec_path = PROCESSED / f"{sid}.json"
        if not rec_path.exists():
            print(f"{sid}: not extracted; run extract first")
            continue
        rec = json.loads(rec_path.read_text())
        f = newest(RAW / sid, ".html")
        assert f is not None
        count = len([x for x in (RAW / sid).glob("*.html") if STAMP.match(x.name)])
        s, d = validate_source(rec, f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"),
                               spec_all["html"][sid], sources, count)
        reports.append(s)
        details.append(d)
        kinds: dict[str, int] = {}
        for i in s["issues"]:  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            kinds[i["kind"]] = kinds.get(i["kind"], 0) + 1
        cov = s["page_data_coverage"]
        print(f"{sid}: passages={s['counts']['passages']} "  # type: ignore[index]
              f"page-data {cov['in_passages']}/{cov['sentences']} "  # type: ignore[index]

FACT_ID = re.compile(r"^[A-Z]{2,4}-[A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)*-\d{3}$")
REQUIRED = ("fact_id", "statement", "topic", "scope_tier", "applies_to", "exceptions", "source",
            "retrieved_at", "validation", "rights_review", "kb_version", "critical")
WORD = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9$%]+(?:[.'’][a-z0-9]+)*")


def words(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return WORD.findall(norm(text))


def longest_shared_run(a: list[str], b: list[str]) -> tuple[int, str]:
    """Longest run of consecutive identical words shared by a and b (dynamic programming)."""
    best, end = 0, 0
    prev = [0] * (len(b) + 1)
    for i in range(1, len(a) + 1):
        cur = [0] * (len(b) + 1)
        ai = a[i - 1]
        for j in range(1, len(b) + 1):
            if ai == b[j - 1]:
                cur[j] = prev[j - 1] + 1
                if cur[j] > best:
                    best, end = cur[j], i
        prev = cur
    return best, " ".join(a[end - best:end])


def load_facts(path: Path = FACTS) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def check_facts(
    facts: list[dict[str, object]],
    sources: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
    l1: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, object]], list[str]]:
    """Integrity and overlap checks. Returns (per-fact rows, errors). Rows hold no source text."""
    errors: list[str] = []
    ids = [str(f.get("fact_id")) for f in facts]
    for dup in sorted({i for i in ids if ids.count(i) > 1}):
        errors.append(f"duplicate fact_id {dup}")
    known = set(ids)
    rows = []
    for f in facts:
        fid = str(f.get("fact_id"))
        for key in REQUIRED:
            if key not in f:
                errors.append(f"{fid}: missing field {key}")
        if not FACT_ID.match(fid):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: fact_id format")
        src = f.get("source")
        if not isinstance(src, dict):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: source must be an object")
            continue
        sid = str(src.get("source_id"))
        man = sources.get(sid)
        if man is None:
            errors.append(f"{fid}: source_id {sid} not in manifest")
            continue
        if man.get("mvp_class") in ("outside_mvp", "pending"):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: cites {sid}, classed {man.get('mvp_class')}")
        url = str(src.get("url", ""))
        if not url.startswith(str(man.get("canonical_url"))):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: url does not start with the manifest canonical_url of {sid}")
        if not url.startswith("https://"):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: url must be an absolute https official URL")
        for ex in f.get("exceptions", []) or []:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            ref = ex.get("fact_id") if isinstance(ex, dict) else None
            if ref and ref not in known:
                errors.append(f"{fid}: exception references unknown fact {ref}")
        # Section and passage provenance resolve against L1 when it is present locally.
        rec = l1.get(sid)
        source_words: list[str] = []
        passage_words: list[str] = []
        if rec is not None:
            secs = {str(s["section_id"]) for s in rec["sections"]}  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            pids = {str(p["passage_id"]): p for p in rec["passages"]}  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            if src.get("section_id") not in secs:
                errors.append(f"{fid}: section_id {src.get('section_id')} not in L1 {sid}")
            for pid in f.get("private_passage_ids", []) or []:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                if pid not in pids:
                    errors.append(f"{fid}: passage {pid} not in L1 {sid}")
                else:
                    passage_words += words(str(pids[pid]["text"]))
            source_words = words(" ".join(str(p["text"]) for p in pids.values()))
        elif "pdf" not in str(man.get("content_format")):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: no L1 record for {sid}; run extract")
        authored = " ".join([str(f.get("statement", "")),
                             *[str(e.get("description", "")) for e in f.get("exceptions", []) or []  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                               if isinstance(e, dict)]])
        run, _ = longest_shared_run(words(authored), source_words) if source_words else (0, "")
        rows.append({
            "fact_id": fid, "source_id": sid, "section_id": src.get("section_id"),
            "topic": f.get("topic"), "scope_tier": f.get("scope_tier"),
            "critical": f.get("critical"),
            "validation_status": (f.get("validation") or {}).get("status"),  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            "rights_status": (f.get("rights_review") or {}).get("status"),  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            "max_shared_run_words": run,
            "overlap_flag": run >= OVERLAP_WORDS,
            "overlap_checked_against": "L1 passages" if source_words else "manual (PDF, D-052)",
        })
    return rows, errors


def load_l1() -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
    return {p.stem: json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted(PROCESSED.glob("S*.json"))}


def run_facts() -> None:
    facts = load_facts()
    rows, errors = check_facts(facts, manifest_sources(), load_l1())
    flagged = [r for r in rows if r["overlap_flag"]]
    CORPUS_META.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (CORPUS_META / "fact_check_report.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"overlap_threshold_words": OVERLAP_WORDS, "facts": rows, "errors": errors},
        indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(f"facts={len(facts)} errors={len(errors)} overlap_flags={len(flagged)}")
    for e in errors:
        print("  ERROR", e)
    for r in flagged:
        print(f"  OVERLAP {r['fact_id']}: {r['max_shared_run_words']} shared words (reword)")
    if errors:
        sys.exit(1)

EXPECTED_SECTIONS = CORPUS_META / "expected_sections.json"
SENTENCE_MIN = 30


def sentences(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [s for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?:;])\s+", norm(text)) if len(s) >= SENTENCE_MIN]


def match_expected(spec: list[dict[str, str]], title: str) -> dict[str, str] | None:
    for item in spec:
        if re.search(item["match"], norm(title)):
            return item
    return None


def resolve_link(href: str, page_url: str, sources: dict[str, dict[str, object]]) -> str | None:
    """Manifest source ID a link points to, by canonical-URL prefix (anchors ignored)."""
    h = href.split("#")[0].split("?")[0].rstrip("/")
    if h.startswith("/"):
        h = "https://www.hdb.gov.sg" + h
    if not h:
        return None
    best: tuple[int, str] | None = None
    for sid, s in sources.items():
        for key in ("canonical_url", "original_url"):
            u = str(s.get(key) or "").split("?")[0].rstrip("/")
            if u and (h == u or h.endswith(u.split("://", 1)[-1])) and (
                best is None or len(u) > best[0]
            ):
                best = (len(u), sid)
        acq = s.get("acquisition")
        if isinstance(acq, dict):
            for key in ("requested_url", "final_url"):
                u = str(acq.get(key) or "").rstrip("/")
                if u and h == u:
                    best = (len(u), sid)
    _ = page_url
    return best[1] if best else None


def validate_source(
    rec: dict[str, object],
    raw_html: str,
    spec: list[dict[str, str]],
    sources: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
    snapshot_count: int,
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], dict[str, object]]:
    """Return (tracked summary with counts/IDs only, private detail with text fragments)."""
    sid = str(rec["source_id"])
    sections = rec["sections"]
    blocks = rec["blocks"]
    passages = rec["passages"]
    assert isinstance(sections, list) and isinstance(blocks, list) and isinstance(passages, list)
    passage_text = norm(" ".join(str(p["text"]) for p in passages))
    by_section: dict[str, list[dict[str, object]]] = {}
    for b in blocks:
        by_section.setdefault(str(b["section_id"]), []).append(b)
    detail: dict[str, object] = {"source_id": sid}
    issues: list[dict[str, str]] = []

    # 1. Accordions: toggles counted on the raw HTML, independently of the tree walker.
    raw_toggles = len(re.findall(r'class="accordion-button[^"]*"', raw_html))
    acc = [s for s in sections if s["kind"] == "accordion"]
    acc_rows = []
    for s in acc:
        own = [s["section_id"], *[x["section_id"] for x in sections
                                  if str(x["section_id"]).startswith(f"{s['section_id']}.")]]
        kinds = sorted({str(b["kind"]) for sec in own for b in by_section.get(str(sec), [])
                        if b["kind"] not in ("heading", "accordion_summary")})
        acc_rows.append({"section_id": s["section_id"], "title": short(str(s["title"])),
                         "body_block_kinds": kinds})
        if not kinds:
            issues.append({"kind": "extraction_failure", "where": str(s["section_id"]),
                           "detail": "accordion body has no extracted content"})
    collapsed = len(re.findall(r'aria-expanded="false"[^>]*>\s*<div class="PAccordion', raw_html))

    # 2. Expected sections from the matrix / data_sources §2.2 versus extracted headings.
    expected_rows = []
    seen_items: set[str] = set()
    for s in sections:
        if s["kind"] == "page":
            continue
        item = match_expected(spec, " > ".join(str(t) for t in s["path"][1:]))  # type: ignore[index]
        own_kinds = sorted({str(b["kind"]) for b in by_section.get(str(s["section_id"]), [])
                            if b["kind"] != "heading"})
        row = {"section_id": s["section_id"], "title": short(str(s["title"])),
               "scope": item["scope"] if item else "unexpected", "content": own_kinds}
        if item:
            seen_items.add(item["match"])
        else:
            issues.append({"kind": "unexpected_section", "where": str(s["section_id"]),
                           "detail": "heading not in the expected-section checklist"})
        expected_rows.append(row)
    for item in spec:
        if item["match"] not in seen_items:
            issues.append({"kind": "missing_section", "where": sid,
                           "detail": f"expected '{item.get('label', item['match'])}' not found"})

    # 3. Independent heading check with the snapshots.py parser (whole page, incl. chrome).
    snap = Snapshot()
    snap.feed(raw_html)
    extracted_titles = {norm(str(s["title"])) for s in sections}
    page_headings = [h for _, h in snap.headings if h]
    unmatched = sorted({h for h in page_headings if h not in extracted_titles})

    # 4. Text coverage: page-data sentences (Sitecore __NEXT_DATA__) found in the passages.
    missing_sents: list[str] = []
    total = found = 0
    if snap.next_data.strip():
        for path, s_ in json_strings(json.loads(snap.next_data)):
            if len(s_) < 40 or s_.startswith(("http", "/", "{")) or ".fields.meta" in path:
                continue
            for sent in sentences(strip_html(s_) if "<" in s_ else s_):
                total += 1
                if sent in passage_text:
                    found += 1
                else:
                    missing_sents.append(sent)
    dom_text = norm(" ".join(snap.text))
    in_dom_not_l1 = [x for x in missing_sents if x in dom_text]
    if in_dom_not_l1:
        issues.append({"kind": "extraction_gap", "where": sid,
                       "detail": f"{len(in_dom_not_l1)} rendered page-data sentence(s) not in "
                                 "passages (see private detail; card/meta text is expected)"})
    detail["page_data_sentences_missing"] = missing_sents
    detail["rendered_but_not_extracted"] = in_dom_not_l1

    # 5. Tables: count on raw HTML vs extracted; spans flagged for manual check.
    root_html = raw_html.split("DestinationLayout_DestinationPageLayout__Cont", 1)[-1]
    raw_tables = len(re.findall(r"<table\b", root_html.split("<footer", 1)[0]))
    tables = [b for b in blocks if b["kind"] == "table"]
    table_rows = []
    for t in tables:
        rows = t["rows"]
        spans = t.get("spans") or []
        assert isinstance(rows, list) and isinstance(spans, list)
        merged = sum(1 for r in spans for c in r if c != [1, 1])
        empty = sum(1 for r in rows for c in r if not str(c).strip())
        table_rows.append({"block_id": t["block_id"], "section_id": t["section_id"],
                           "rows": len(rows), "cells": sum(len(r) for r in rows),
                           "header_rows": t.get("header_rows"), "merged_cells": merged,
                           "empty_cells": empty, "nested_in": t.get("nested_in")})
        if merged:

                           "detail": f"{merged} merged cell(s): confirm which rows a value "
                                     "applies to against the rendered page"})
    if raw_tables != len(tables):
        issues.append({"kind": "extraction_failure", "where": sid,
                       "detail": f"raw <table> count {raw_tables} != extracted {len(tables)}"})

    # 6. Links: classified and resolved against the manifest.
    link_rows: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    for b in blocks:
        for ln in b.get("links", []) or []:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            href = str(ln["href"])

            key = href.split("?si=")[0]

                                             "target_source_id": target, "count": 0,
                                             "sections": []})
            row["count"] = int(row["count"]) + 1  # type: ignore[call-overload]
            secs = row["sections"]
            assert isinstance(secs, list)
            if b["section_id"] not in secs:
                secs.append(b["section_id"])
    for row in link_rows.values():
        t = row["target_source_id"]
        row["status"] = (
            "same_page" if row["kind"] == "same_page" and t in (None, sid)
            else f"manifest:{sources[str(t)]['mvp_class']}" if t
            else "transactional_or_service" if re.search(r"services2|homes\.hdb|iam\.hdb|singpass",
                                                        str(row["href"]))
            else "unmapped"
        )

    # 7. Duplicates and malformed passages.
    hashes: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for p in passages:
        hashes.setdefault(str(p["text_sha256"]), []).append(str(p["passage_id"]))
    dup_blocks: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for b in blocks:
        if b["kind"] in ("paragraph", "list", "table", "footnote") and len(str(b["text"])) > 60:
            dup_blocks.setdefault(hashlib.sha256(norm(str(b["text"])).encode()).hexdigest(),
                                  []).append(str(b["block_id"]))
    empty_sections = [s["section_id"] for s in sections
                      if not [b for b in by_section.get(str(s["section_id"]), [])
                              if b["kind"] != "heading"]]
    ids = [p["passage_id"] for p in passages]

    # 8. Temporal metadata.
    temporal = {
        "retrieved_at": sorted({str(p["retrieved_at"]) for p in passages}),
        "page_last_updated": sorted({str(p["page_last_updated"]) for p in passages}),
        "effective_date_known": any(p["policy_effective_date"] for p in passages),
    }
    if not temporal["effective_date_known"]:
        issues.append({"kind": "temporal_gap", "where": sid,
                       "detail": "no stated effective date; page 'last updated' date only"})
    if snapshot_count < 2:
        issues.append({"kind": "limitation", "where": sid,
                       "detail": "single default-state snapshot: no default-vs-expanded diff. "

    summary = {
        "source_id": sid,
        "raw_sha256": rec["raw_sha256"],
        "extractor_version": rec["extractor_version"],
        "snapshots": snapshot_count,
        "counts": {

            "tables": len(tables), "raw_tables": raw_tables,
            "accordions_extracted": len(acc), "accordion_toggles_raw": raw_toggles,
            "accordions_collapsed_at_capture": collapsed,
        },
        "accordions": acc_rows,
        "sections": expected_rows,
        "headings_not_extracted": {"count": len(unmatched), "labels": [short(h) for h in unmatched]},
        "page_data_coverage": {"sentences": total, "in_passages": found,
                               "rendered_but_not_extracted": len(in_dom_not_l1)},
        "tables": table_rows,
        "links": sorted(link_rows.values(), key=lambda r: str(r["href"])),
        "duplicates": {
            "passages": [v for v in hashes.values() if len(v) > 1],
            "blocks": [v for v in dup_blocks.values() if len(v) > 1],
        },
        "empty_sections": empty_sections,
        "passage_ids_unique": len(ids) == len(set(ids)),
        "temporal": temporal,
        "issues": issues,
    }
    return summary, detail

    return WORD.findall(norm(text))


def longest_shared_run(a: list[str], b: list[str]) -> tuple[int, str]:
    """Longest run of consecutive identical words shared by a and b (dynamic programming)."""
    best, end = 0, 0
    prev = [0] * (len(b) + 1)
    for i in range(1, len(a) + 1):
        cur = [0] * (len(b) + 1)
        ai = a[i - 1]
        for j in range(1, len(b) + 1):
            if ai == b[j - 1]:
                cur[j] = prev[j - 1] + 1
                if cur[j] > best:
                    best, end = cur[j], i
        prev = cur
    return best, " ".join(a[end - best:end])


def load_facts(path: Path = FACTS) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def check_facts(
    facts: list[dict[str, object]],
    sources: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
    l1: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, object]], list[str]]:
    """Integrity and overlap checks. Returns (per-fact rows, errors). Rows hold no source text."""
    errors: list[str] = []
    ids = [str(f.get("fact_id")) for f in facts]
    for dup in sorted({i for i in ids if ids.count(i) > 1}):
        errors.append(f"duplicate fact_id {dup}")
    known = set(ids)
    rows = []
    for f in facts:
        fid = str(f.get("fact_id"))
        for key in REQUIRED:
            if key not in f:
                errors.append(f"{fid}: missing field {key}")
        if not FACT_ID.match(fid):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: fact_id format")
        src = f.get("source")
        if not isinstance(src, dict):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: source must be an object")
            continue
        sid = str(src.get("source_id"))
        man = sources.get(sid)
        if man is None:
            errors.append(f"{fid}: source_id {sid} not in manifest")
            continue
        if man.get("mvp_class") in ("outside_mvp", "pending"):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: cites {sid}, classed {man.get('mvp_class')}")
        url = str(src.get("url", ""))
        if not url.startswith(str(man.get("canonical_url"))):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: url does not start with the manifest canonical_url of {sid}")
        if not url.startswith("https://"):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: url must be an absolute https official URL")
        for ex in f.get("exceptions", []) or []:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            ref = ex.get("fact_id") if isinstance(ex, dict) else None
            if ref and ref not in known:
                errors.append(f"{fid}: exception references unknown fact {ref}")
        # Section and passage provenance resolve against L1 when it is present locally.
        rec = l1.get(sid)
        source_words: list[str] = []
        passage_words: list[str] = []
        if rec is not None:
            secs = {str(s["section_id"]) for s in rec["sections"]}  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            pids = {str(p["passage_id"]): p for p in rec["passages"]}  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            if src.get("section_id") not in secs:
                errors.append(f"{fid}: section_id {src.get('section_id')} not in L1 {sid}")
            for pid in f.get("private_passage_ids", []) or []:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                if pid not in pids:
                    errors.append(f"{fid}: passage {pid} not in L1 {sid}")
                else:
                    passage_words += words(str(pids[pid]["text"]))
            source_words = words(" ".join(str(p["text"]) for p in pids.values()))
        elif "pdf" not in str(man.get("content_format")):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: no L1 record for {sid}; run extract")
        authored = " ".join([str(f.get("statement", "")),
                             *[str(e.get("description", "")) for e in f.get("exceptions", []) or []  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                               if isinstance(e, dict)]])
        run, _ = longest_shared_run(words(authored), source_words) if source_words else (0, "")
        rows.append({
            "fact_id": fid, "source_id": sid, "section_id": src.get("section_id"),
            "topic": f.get("topic"), "scope_tier": f.get("scope_tier"),
            "critical": f.get("critical"),
            "validation_status": (f.get("validation") or {}).get("status"),  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            "rights_status": (f.get("rights_review") or {}).get("status"),  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            "max_shared_run_words": run,
            "overlap_flag": run >= OVERLAP_WORDS,
            "overlap_checked_against": "L1 passages" if source_words else "manual (PDF, D-052)",
        })
    return rows, errors


def load_l1() -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
    return {p.stem: json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted(PROCESSED.glob("S*.json"))}


def run_facts() -> None:
    facts = load_facts()
    rows, errors = check_facts(facts, manifest_sources(), load_l1())
    flagged = [r for r in rows if r["overlap_flag"]]
    CORPUS_META.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (CORPUS_META / "fact_check_report.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"overlap_threshold_words": OVERLAP_WORDS, "facts": rows, "errors": errors},
        indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(f"facts={len(facts)} errors={len(errors)} overlap_flags={len(flagged)}")
    for e in errors:
        print("  ERROR", e)
    for r in flagged:
        print(f"  OVERLAP {r['fact_id']}: {r['max_shared_run_words']} shared words (reword)")
    if errors:
        sys.exit(1)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- freeze ------------------
KB_VERSION = "kb-2026-10-28.1"


def sha_file(p: Path) -> str | None:
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.exists() else None


def run_freeze() -> None:
    facts = load_facts()
    sources = manifest_sources()
    by: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {"topic": {}, "scope_tier": {}, "validation": {}, "rights": {}}
    for f in facts:
        for key, val in (("topic", f["topic"]), ("scope_tier", f["scope_tier"]),
                         ("validation", f["validation"]["status"]),  # type: ignore[index]
                         ("rights", f["rights_review"]["status"])):  # type: ignore[index]
            by[key][str(val)] = by[key].get(str(val), 0) + 1
    versions = {str(f["kb_version"]) for f in facts}
    if versions != {KB_VERSION}:
        sys.exit(f"kb_version mismatch in facts: {sorted(versions)}")
    cited = sorted({str(f["source"]["source_id"]) for f in facts})  # type: ignore[index]
    l1 = load_l1()
    frozen = {
        "kb_version": KB_VERSION,
        "policy_period": "HDB sources retrieved 28 Oct 2026 (UTC); no stated effective dates",
        "extractor_version": EXTRACTOR_VERSION,
        "sources": [
            {"source_id": sid, "retrieved_at": sources[sid]["acquisition"]["retrieved_at"],  # type: ignore[index]
             "raw_sha256": sources[sid]["acquisition"]["raw_sha256"],  # type: ignore[index]
             "text_sha256": sources[sid]["acquisition"]["text_sha256"],  # type: ignore[index]
             "page_last_updated": sources[sid].get("page_last_updated"),
             "effective_date": sources[sid].get("effective_date"),
             "effective_date_status": sources[sid].get("effective_date_status"),
             "l1_passages": len(l1[sid]["passages"]) if sid in l1 else None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
             "facts": sum(1 for f in facts if f["source"]["source_id"] == sid)}  # type: ignore[index]
            for sid in cited
        ],
        "fact_count": len(facts),
        "fact_counts": by,
        "files_sha256": {
            str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha_file(p)
            for p in (FACTS, VISUALS, COVERAGE, MANIFEST, EXPECTED_SECTIONS,
                      CORPUS_META / "extraction_report.json",
                      CORPUS_META / "fact_check_report.json")
        },
        "freeze_status": "candidate (awaiting developer approval of corpus and scope)",
    }
    (CORPUS_META / "corpus_version.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(frozen, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(f"frozen {KB_VERSION}: {len(facts)} facts from {len(cited)} sources")


def main() -> None:
    cmd = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
    commands = {"extract": run_extract, "validate": run_validate, "facts": run_facts,
                "freeze": run_freeze}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- validate ----------------
EXPECTED_SECTIONS = CORPUS_META / "expected_sections.json"
SENTENCE_MIN = 30


def sentences(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [s for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?:;])\s+", norm(text)) if len(s) >= SENTENCE_MIN]


def match_expected(spec: list[dict[str, str]], title: str) -> dict[str, str] | None:
    for item in spec:
        if re.search(item["match"], norm(title)):
            return item
    return None


def resolve_link(href: str, page_url: str, sources: dict[str, dict[str, object]]) -> str | None:
    """Manifest source ID a link points to, by canonical-URL prefix (anchors ignored)."""
    h = href.split("#")[0].split("?")[0].rstrip("/")
    if h.startswith("/"):
        h = "https://www.hdb.gov.sg" + h
    if not h:
        return None
    best: tuple[int, str] | None = None
    for sid, s in sources.items():
        for key in ("canonical_url", "original_url"):
            u = str(s.get(key) or "").split("?")[0].rstrip("/")
            if u and (h == u or h.endswith(u.split("://", 1)[-1])) and (
                best is None or len(u) > best[0]
            ):
                best = (len(u), sid)
        acq = s.get("acquisition")
        if isinstance(acq, dict):
            for key in ("requested_url", "final_url"):
                u = str(acq.get(key) or "").rstrip("/")
                if u and h == u:
                    best = (len(u), sid)
    _ = page_url
    return best[1] if best else None


def validate_source(
    rec: dict[str, object],
    raw_html: str,
    spec: list[dict[str, str]],
    sources: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
    snapshot_count: int,
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], dict[str, object]]:
    """Return (tracked summary with counts/IDs only, private detail with text fragments)."""
    sid = str(rec["source_id"])
    sections = rec["sections"]
    blocks = rec["blocks"]
    passages = rec["passages"]
    assert isinstance(sections, list) and isinstance(blocks, list) and isinstance(passages, list)
    passage_text = norm(" ".join(str(p["text"]) for p in passages))
    by_section: dict[str, list[dict[str, object]]] = {}
    for b in blocks:
        by_section.setdefault(str(b["section_id"]), []).append(b)
    detail: dict[str, object] = {"source_id": sid}
    issues: list[dict[str, str]] = []

    # 1. Accordions: toggles counted on the raw HTML, independently of the tree walker.
    raw_toggles = len(re.findall(r'class="accordion-button[^"]*"', raw_html))
    acc = [s for s in sections if s["kind"] == "accordion"]
    acc_rows = []
    for s in acc:
        own = [s["section_id"], *[x["section_id"] for x in sections
                                  if str(x["section_id"]).startswith(f"{s['section_id']}.")]]
        kinds = sorted({str(b["kind"]) for sec in own for b in by_section.get(str(sec), [])
                        if b["kind"] not in ("heading", "accordion_summary")})
        acc_rows.append({"section_id": s["section_id"], "title": short(str(s["title"])),
                         "body_block_kinds": kinds})
        if not kinds:
            issues.append({"kind": "extraction_failure", "where": str(s["section_id"]),
                           "detail": "accordion body has no extracted content"})
    collapsed = len(re.findall(r'aria-expanded="false"[^>]*>\s*<div class="PAccordion', raw_html))

    # 2. Expected sections from the matrix / data_sources §2.2 versus extracted headings.
    expected_rows = []
    seen_items: set[str] = set()
    for s in sections:
        if s["kind"] == "page":
            continue
        item = match_expected(spec, " > ".join(str(t) for t in s["path"][1:]))  # type: ignore[index]
        own_kinds = sorted({str(b["kind"]) for b in by_section.get(str(s["section_id"]), [])
                            if b["kind"] != "heading"})
        row = {"section_id": s["section_id"], "title": short(str(s["title"])),
               "scope": item["scope"] if item else "unexpected", "content": own_kinds}
        if item:
            seen_items.add(item["match"])
        else:
            issues.append({"kind": "unexpected_section", "where": str(s["section_id"]),
                           "detail": "heading not in the expected-section checklist"})
        expected_rows.append(row)
    for item in spec:
        if item["match"] not in seen_items:
            issues.append({"kind": "missing_section", "where": sid,
                           "detail": f"expected '{item.get('label', item['match'])}' not found"})

    # 3. Independent heading check with the snapshots.py parser (whole page, incl. chrome).
    snap = Snapshot()
    snap.feed(raw_html)
    extracted_titles = {norm(str(s["title"])) for s in sections}
    page_headings = [h for _, h in snap.headings if h]
    unmatched = sorted({h for h in page_headings if h not in extracted_titles})

    # 4. Text coverage: page-data sentences (Sitecore __NEXT_DATA__) found in the passages.
    missing_sents: list[str] = []
    total = found = 0
    if snap.next_data.strip():
        for path, s_ in json_strings(json.loads(snap.next_data)):
            if len(s_) < 40 or s_.startswith(("http", "/", "{")) or ".fields.meta" in path:
                continue
            for sent in sentences(strip_html(s_) if "<" in s_ else s_):
                total += 1
                if sent in passage_text:
                    found += 1
                else:
                    missing_sents.append(sent)
    dom_text = norm(" ".join(snap.text))
    in_dom_not_l1 = [x for x in missing_sents if x in dom_text]
    if in_dom_not_l1:
        issues.append({"kind": "extraction_gap", "where": sid,
                       "detail": f"{len(in_dom_not_l1)} rendered page-data sentence(s) not in "
                                 "passages (see private detail; card/meta text is expected)"})
    detail["page_data_sentences_missing"] = missing_sents
    detail["rendered_but_not_extracted"] = in_dom_not_l1

    # 5. Tables: count on raw HTML vs extracted; spans flagged for manual check.
    root_html = raw_html.split("DestinationLayout_DestinationPageLayout__Cont", 1)[-1]
    raw_tables = len(re.findall(r"<table\b", root_html.split("<footer", 1)[0]))
    tables = [b for b in blocks if b["kind"] == "table"]
    table_rows = []
    for t in tables:
        rows = t["rows"]
        spans = t.get("spans") or []
        assert isinstance(rows, list) and isinstance(spans, list)
        merged = sum(1 for r in spans for c in r if c != [1, 1])
        empty = sum(1 for r in rows for c in r if not str(c).strip())
        table_rows.append({"block_id": t["block_id"], "section_id": t["section_id"],
                           "rows": len(rows), "cells": sum(len(r) for r in rows),
                           "header_rows": t.get("header_rows"), "merged_cells": merged,
                           "empty_cells": empty, "nested_in": t.get("nested_in")})
        if merged:
            issues.append({"kind": "manual_check", "where": str(t["block_id"]),
                           "detail": f"{merged} merged cell(s): confirm which rows a value "
                                     "applies to against the rendered page"})
    if raw_tables != len(tables):
        issues.append({"kind": "extraction_failure", "where": sid,
                       "detail": f"raw <table> count {raw_tables} != extracted {len(tables)}"})

    # 6. Links: classified and resolved against the manifest.
    link_rows: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    for b in blocks:
        for ln in b.get("links", []) or []:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            href = str(ln["href"])
            if ln["kind"] in ("image", "video"):
                continue
            target = resolve_link(href, "", sources)
            key = href.split("?si=")[0]
            row = link_rows.setdefault(key, {"href": key[:160], "kind": ln["kind"],
                                             "target_source_id": target, "count": 0,
                                             "sections": []})
            row["count"] = int(row["count"]) + 1  # type: ignore[call-overload]
            secs = row["sections"]
            assert isinstance(secs, list)
            if b["section_id"] not in secs:
                secs.append(b["section_id"])
    for row in link_rows.values():
        t = row["target_source_id"]
        row["status"] = (
            "same_page" if row["kind"] == "same_page" and t in (None, sid)
            else f"manifest:{sources[str(t)]['mvp_class']}" if t
            else "transactional_or_service" if re.search(r"services2|homes\.hdb|iam\.hdb|singpass",
                                                        str(row["href"]))
            else "unmapped"
        )

    # 7. Duplicates and malformed passages.
    hashes: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for p in passages:
        hashes.setdefault(str(p["text_sha256"]), []).append(str(p["passage_id"]))
    dup_blocks: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for b in blocks:
        if b["kind"] in ("paragraph", "list", "table", "footnote") and len(str(b["text"])) > 60:
            dup_blocks.setdefault(hashlib.sha256(norm(str(b["text"])).encode()).hexdigest(),
                                  []).append(str(b["block_id"]))
    empty_sections = [s["section_id"] for s in sections
                      if not [b for b in by_section.get(str(s["section_id"]), [])
                              if b["kind"] != "heading"]]
    ids = [p["passage_id"] for p in passages]

    # 8. Temporal metadata.
    temporal = {
        "retrieved_at": sorted({str(p["retrieved_at"]) for p in passages}),
        "page_last_updated": sorted({str(p["page_last_updated"]) for p in passages}),
        "effective_date_known": any(p["policy_effective_date"] for p in passages),
    }
    if not temporal["effective_date_known"]:
        issues.append({"kind": "temporal_gap", "where": sid,
                       "detail": "no stated effective date; page 'last updated' date only"})
    if snapshot_count < 2:
        issues.append({"kind": "limitation", "where": sid,
                       "detail": "single default-state snapshot: no default-vs-expanded diff. "
                                 "Mitigation: collapsed panels present in DOM + page-data check"})

    summary = {
        "source_id": sid,
        "raw_sha256": rec["raw_sha256"],
        "extractor_version": rec["extractor_version"],
        "snapshots": snapshot_count,
        "counts": {
            "sections": len(sections), "passages": len(passages), "blocks": len(blocks),
            "tables": len(tables), "raw_tables": raw_tables,
            "accordions_extracted": len(acc), "accordion_toggles_raw": raw_toggles,
            "accordions_collapsed_at_capture": collapsed,
        },
        "accordions": acc_rows,
        "sections": expected_rows,
        "headings_not_extracted": {"count": len(unmatched), "labels": [short(h) for h in unmatched]},
        "page_data_coverage": {"sentences": total, "in_passages": found,
                               "rendered_but_not_extracted": len(in_dom_not_l1)},
        "tables": table_rows,
        "links": sorted(link_rows.values(), key=lambda r: str(r["href"])),
        "duplicates": {
            "passages": [v for v in hashes.values() if len(v) > 1],
            "blocks": [v for v in dup_blocks.values() if len(v) > 1],
        },
        "empty_sections": empty_sections,
        "passage_ids_unique": len(ids) == len(set(ids)),
        "temporal": temporal,
        "issues": issues,
    }
    return summary, detail


def run_validate() -> None:
    from snapshots import json_strings as _js  # noqa: F401  (import check only)

    spec_all = json.loads(EXPECTED_SECTIONS.read_text())
    sources = manifest_sources()
    reports, details = [], []
    for sid in sorted(spec_all["html"]):
        rec_path = PROCESSED / f"{sid}.json"
        if not rec_path.exists():
            print(f"{sid}: not extracted; run extract first")
            continue
        rec = json.loads(rec_path.read_text())
        f = newest(RAW / sid, ".html")
        assert f is not None
        count = len([x for x in (RAW / sid).glob("*.html") if STAMP.match(x.name)])
        s, d = validate_source(rec, f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"),
                               spec_all["html"][sid], sources, count)
        reports.append(s)
        details.append(d)
        kinds: dict[str, int] = {}
        for i in s["issues"]:  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            kinds[i["kind"]] = kinds.get(i["kind"], 0) + 1
        cov = s["page_data_coverage"]
        print(f"{sid}: passages={s['counts']['passages']} "  # type: ignore[index]
              f"page-data {cov['in_passages']}/{cov['sentences']} "  # type: ignore[index]
              f"rendered-not-extracted={cov['rendered_but_not_extracted']} issues={kinds}")  # type: ignore[index]
    pdfs = []
    for sid, item in sorted(spec_all["pdf"].items()):
        acq = sources[sid]["acquisition"]
        assert isinstance(acq, dict)
        pdfs.append({"source_id": sid, "raw_sha256": acq.get("raw_sha256"),
                     "method": "manual page review (D-052); no text extraction", **item})
    report = {
        "report_version": EXTRACTOR_VERSION,
        "generated_from": "data/private_corpus (local only)",
        "note": "Counts, IDs and short heading labels only; no source passages (D-054).",
        "html_sources": reports,
        "pdf_sources": pdfs,
    }
    CORPUS_META.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (CORPUS_META / "extraction_report.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(report, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    (PROCESSED / "validation_detail.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(details, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print("wrote data/corpus/extraction_report.json (+ private validation_detail.json)")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- facts -------------------
FACT_ID = re.compile(r"^[A-Z]{2,4}-[A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)*-\d{3}$")
REQUIRED = ("fact_id", "statement", "topic", "scope_tier", "applies_to", "exceptions", "source",
            "retrieved_at", "validation", "rights_review", "kb_version", "critical")
WORD = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9$%]+(?:[.'’][a-z0-9]+)*")


def words(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return WORD.findall(norm(text))


def longest_shared_run(a: list[str], b: list[str]) -> tuple[int, str]:
    """Longest run of consecutive identical words shared by a and b (dynamic programming)."""
    best, end = 0, 0
    prev = [0] * (len(b) + 1)
    for i in range(1, len(a) + 1):
        cur = [0] * (len(b) + 1)
        ai = a[i - 1]
        for j in range(1, len(b) + 1):
            if ai == b[j - 1]:
                cur[j] = prev[j - 1] + 1
                if cur[j] > best:
                    best, end = cur[j], i
        prev = cur
    return best, " ".join(a[end - best:end])


def load_facts(path: Path = FACTS) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def check_facts(
    facts: list[dict[str, object]],
    sources: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
    l1: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, object]], list[str]]:
    """Integrity and overlap checks. Returns (per-fact rows, errors). Rows hold no source text."""
    errors: list[str] = []
    ids = [str(f.get("fact_id")) for f in facts]
    for dup in sorted({i for i in ids if ids.count(i) > 1}):
        errors.append(f"duplicate fact_id {dup}")
    known = set(ids)
    rows = []
    for f in facts:
        fid = str(f.get("fact_id"))
        for key in REQUIRED:
            if key not in f:
                errors.append(f"{fid}: missing field {key}")
        if not FACT_ID.match(fid):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: fact_id format")
        src = f.get("source")
        if not isinstance(src, dict):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: source must be an object")
            continue
        sid = str(src.get("source_id"))
        man = sources.get(sid)
        if man is None:
            errors.append(f"{fid}: source_id {sid} not in manifest")
            continue
        if man.get("mvp_class") in ("outside_mvp", "pending"):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: cites {sid}, classed {man.get('mvp_class')}")
        url = str(src.get("url", ""))
        if not url.startswith(str(man.get("canonical_url"))):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: url does not start with the manifest canonical_url of {sid}")
        if not url.startswith("https://"):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: url must be an absolute https official URL")
        for ex in f.get("exceptions", []) or []:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            ref = ex.get("fact_id") if isinstance(ex, dict) else None
            if ref and ref not in known:
                errors.append(f"{fid}: exception references unknown fact {ref}")
        # Section and passage provenance resolve against L1 when it is present locally.
        rec = l1.get(sid)
        source_words: list[str] = []
        passage_words: list[str] = []
        if rec is not None:
            secs = {str(s["section_id"]) for s in rec["sections"]}  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            pids = {str(p["passage_id"]): p for p in rec["passages"]}  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            if src.get("section_id") not in secs:
                errors.append(f"{fid}: section_id {src.get('section_id')} not in L1 {sid}")
            for pid in f.get("private_passage_ids", []) or []:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                if pid not in pids:
                    errors.append(f"{fid}: passage {pid} not in L1 {sid}")
                else:
                    passage_words += words(str(pids[pid]["text"]))
            source_words = words(" ".join(str(p["text"]) for p in pids.values()))
        elif "pdf" not in str(man.get("content_format")):
            errors.append(f"{fid}: no L1 record for {sid}; run extract")
        authored = " ".join([str(f.get("statement", "")),
                             *[str(e.get("description", "")) for e in f.get("exceptions", []) or []  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                               if isinstance(e, dict)]])
        run, _ = longest_shared_run(words(authored), source_words) if source_words else (0, "")
        rows.append({
            "fact_id": fid, "source_id": sid, "section_id": src.get("section_id"),
            "topic": f.get("topic"), "scope_tier": f.get("scope_tier"),
            "critical": f.get("critical"),
            "validation_status": (f.get("validation") or {}).get("status"),  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            "rights_status": (f.get("rights_review") or {}).get("status"),  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            "max_shared_run_words": run,
            "overlap_flag": run >= OVERLAP_WORDS,
            "overlap_checked_against": "L1 passages" if source_words else "manual (PDF, D-052)",
        })
    return rows, errors


def load_l1() -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
    return {p.stem: json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted(PROCESSED.glob("S*.json"))}


def run_facts() -> None:
    facts = load_facts()
    rows, errors = check_facts(facts, manifest_sources(), load_l1())
    flagged = [r for r in rows if r["overlap_flag"]]
    CORPUS_META.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (CORPUS_META / "fact_check_report.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"overlap_threshold_words": OVERLAP_WORDS, "facts": rows, "errors": errors},
        indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(f"facts={len(facts)} errors={len(errors)} overlap_flags={len(flagged)}")
    for e in errors:
        print("  ERROR", e)
    for r in flagged:
        print(f"  OVERLAP {r['fact_id']}: {r['max_shared_run_words']} shared words (reword)")
    if errors:
        sys.exit(1)

"""Typed contracts (architecture §5). This module imports nothing from the package.

Only the knowledge-base contracts exist so far: the remaining pipeline contracts are added
when their stages are built, so nothing here is an unused stub.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import date
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, HttpUrl, field_validator


class Tier(StrEnum):
    CORE = "core"
    LIMITED = "limited"
    CONTEXT = "context"
    EXCLUDED = "excluded"


class Topic(StrEnum):
    # in scope (tier fixed by D-008)
    HOUSEHOLD_COMPOSITION = "household_composition"
    APPLICATION_REQUIREMENTS = "application_requirements"
    HFE_PROCESS = "hfe_process"
    HFE_DOCUMENTS = "hfe_documents"
    PRIORITY_CONSIDERATIONS = "priority_considerations"
    NON_SELECTION = "non_selection"
    HFE_GRANT_LOAN_CONTEXT = "hfe_grant_loan_context"
    # excluded (D-008): handled by the coverage gate, never by facts
    GRANT_LOAN_CALCULATION = "grant_loan_calculation"
    FINANCING_AFFORDABILITY = "financing_affordability"
    BALLOT_ODDS = "ballot_odds"
    POST_PURCHASE = "post_purchase"
    ELIGIBILITY_DETERMINATION = "eligibility_determination"
    OTHER_HOUSING = "other_housing"
    UNRELATED = "unrelated"


# Single source of truth for the coverage gate and for fact tiers (D-008, REQ-SCP-012).
TOPIC_TIER: dict[Topic, Tier] = {
    Topic.HOUSEHOLD_COMPOSITION: Tier.CORE,
    Topic.APPLICATION_REQUIREMENTS: Tier.CORE,
    Topic.HFE_PROCESS: Tier.CORE,
    Topic.HFE_DOCUMENTS: Tier.CORE,
    Topic.PRIORITY_CONSIDERATIONS: Tier.LIMITED,
    Topic.NON_SELECTION: Tier.LIMITED,
    Topic.HFE_GRANT_LOAN_CONTEXT: Tier.CONTEXT,
    Topic.GRANT_LOAN_CALCULATION: Tier.EXCLUDED,
    Topic.FINANCING_AFFORDABILITY: Tier.EXCLUDED,
    Topic.BALLOT_ODDS: Tier.EXCLUDED,
    Topic.POST_PURCHASE: Tier.EXCLUDED,
    Topic.ELIGIBILITY_DETERMINATION: Tier.EXCLUDED,
    Topic.OTHER_HOUSING: Tier.EXCLUDED,
    Topic.UNRELATED: Tier.EXCLUDED,
}

FACT_ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Z]{2,4}-[A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)*-\d{3}$")


class _Frozen(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)


class SourceRef(_Frozen):
    """Where a fact comes from. Resolves through data/sources_manifest.json (D-006)."""

    source_id: str
    section_id: str  # L1 section ID, e.g. "S01.a.2"; stable while the snapshot hash holds
    section: str  # human-readable heading path on the official page
    url: HttpUrl  # official page (with ?anchor= where HDB provides one)
    locator: str | None = None  # e.g. table row or PDF page; authored, not quoted


class FactException(_Frozen):
    description: str
    fact_id: str | None = None  # the fact that states the exception in full, if any


class Validation(_Frozen):
    # draft -> snapshot_checked (agent, against the captured source) -> verified (developer,
    # against the live official page). Rejected facts are kept for audit, never used.
    status: Literal["draft", "snapshot_checked", "verified", "rejected"]
    method: str
    validated_at: date | None = None
    notes: str = ""


class RightsReview(_Frozen):
    # overlap_checked = local 8-word overlap check passed and read by the author (D-054);
    # cleared = developer's manual rights read before submission (REQ-LIC-015).
    status: Literal["pending", "overlap_checked", "cleared", "rejected"]
    max_shared_run_words: int | None = None
    notes: str = ""


class PolicyFact(_Frozen):
    """One independently authored, source-attributed policy fact (03 §2.5, D-023, D-031)."""

    fact_id: str
    statement: str = Field(min_length=20)
    topic: Topic
    scope_tier: Tier
    aliases: list[str] = []
    applies_to: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    exceptions: list[FactException] = []
    source: SourceRef
    private_passage_ids: list[str] = []  # provenance only; never needed at runtime (D-006)
    retrieved_at: date
    page_last_updated: date | None = None
    effective_from: date | None = None
    effective_to: date | None = None
    effective_date_note: str = ""
    critical: bool  # policy-critical: needs developer verification before use (D-058)
    validation: Validation
    rights_review: RightsReview
    kb_version: str

    @field_validator("fact_id")
    @classmethod
    def _fact_id_format(cls, v: str) -> str:
        if not FACT_ID_PATTERN.match(v):
            raise ValueError(f"fact_id {v!r} does not match {FACT_ID_PATTERN.pattern}")
        return v

    @field_validator("scope_tier")
    @classmethod
    def _not_excluded(cls, v: Tier) -> Tier:
        if v is Tier.EXCLUDED:
            raise ValueError("excluded topics are redirected by the gate, never stored as facts")
        return v

    def tier_matches_topic(self) -> bool:
        return TOPIC_TIER[self.topic] is self.scope_tier

    def usable(self) -> bool:
        """Runtime eligibility of the fact (D-058, PROPOSED).

        Critical facts must be developer-verified; others may be used once checked against the
        captured snapshot. Rights review must at least have passed the overlap check.
        """
        if self.validation.status == "rejected" or self.rights_review.status in (
            "pending",
            "rejected",
        ):
            return False
        if self.validation.status == "verified":
            return True
        return self.validation.status == "snapshot_checked" and not self.critical


class ManifestSource(BaseModel):
    """The subset of a data/sources_manifest.json record the runtime needs."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="ignore", frozen=True)

    source_id: str
    title: str
    canonical_url: HttpUrl | None
    mvp_class: Literal[
        "essential", "supporting", "context_only", "outside_mvp", "pending"
    ]
    page_last_updated: date | None = None


class VisualResource(_Frozen):
    """An official infographic or video, shown as a link only (REQ-SRC-010/011, D-049)."""

    resource_id: str  # manifest media ID, e.g. "M03"
    kind: Literal["infographic", "video"]
    title: str
    url: HttpUrl  # official page or video; media files are never downloaded or embedded
    host_page_source_id: str
    topics: list[Topic] = Field(min_length=1)
    stages: list[str] = Field(min_length=1)
    display_when: str  # authored display condition, applied by the report stage
    evidence: Literal[False] = False  # never policy evidence
